_comment: MongoDB example for Aquadactyl/Manta. Build the accompanying Dockerfile on the node before importing.
name: MongoDB 8.3.17 (Manta)
author: repgraphics@euphoriadevelopment.uk
description: Version-matched MongoDB installer and runtime. Runs mongod in the foreground and stops gracefully with SIGTERM. Existing databases are never reinitialized by the installer.

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
: "${MONGO_USER:?Set the MongoDB admin username}"
: "${MONGO_USER_PASS:?Set the MongoDB admin password}"
cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p mongodb logs
if [[ -n "$(find mongodb -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ]]; then
    echo "Existing MongoDB data found. Installation stopped without changing it; update the runtime image and startup settings to recover an existing server." >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [[ ! -e mongod.conf ]]; then
    cat > mongod.conf <<'CONFIG'
storage:
  dbPath: /home/container/mongodb
security:
  authorization: enabled
processManagement:
  fork: false
CONFIG
fi
mongod --dbpath /mnt/server/mongodb --port 27017 --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --logpath /mnt/server/logs/install.log &
mongo_pid=$!
cleanup() {
    kill -TERM "$mongo_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$mongo_pid" || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT
ready=false
for ((attempt=0; attempt<60; attempt++)); do
    if ! kill -0 "$mongo_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        cat /mnt/server/logs/install.log >&2
        echo "MongoDB exited during installation." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    if mongosh --quiet --norc --host 127.0.0.1 --port 27017 --eval 'quit(db.adminCommand({ping: 1}).ok === 1 ? 0 : 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        ready=true
        break
    fi
    sleep 1
done
if [[ "$ready" != true ]]; then
    tail -n 50 /mnt/server/logs/install.log >&2
    echo "MongoDB did not become ready within 60 attempts." >&2
    exit 1
fi
mongosh --quiet --norc --host 127.0.0.1 --port 27017 --eval 'db.getSiblingDB("admin").createUser({user: process.env.MONGO_USER, pwd: process.env.MONGO_USER_PASS, roles: ["root"]})'
kill -TERM "$mongo_pid"
wait "$mongo_pid"
trap - EXIT
echo "MongoDB installation completed."

variables.name: Mongo Admin Username
variables.description: The existing admin username when recovering a server.

variables.name: Mongo Admin Password
variables.description: Used when initializing a new database. Changing this value does not change an existing database password.
